stop.title: Stop this game?
stop.text: neoOMSI saves your run, says goodbye to any LAN players and closes. If it hasn't ended after 8 seconds, it's forced to close and the run isn't saved.
stop.saved: The game has ended, your run is saved.
stop.forced: The game didn't end in time and was forced to close.

missing.hint: Install or re-enable what is named, or check the load order. Files missing inside a mod usually need a new copy of that mod.
